name: Reverse Engineering & Security Audit Pack
note: Each task runs a real command. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly. No services are involved: ELF and PE test images are assembled byte by byte in the tests, so no compiler or sample binary is needed. SCA-01..03 (SBOM, hash pinning, CVE correlation) are rule-only and have no starter code, so no task verifies them.

eval_tasks.title: AST analyzer flags dangerous sinks
eval_tasks.instruction: eval/exec, subprocess shell=True and dynamically built SQL must each be reported as HIGH, and safe equivalents must stay clean.
assertions: subprocess shell=True produces SEC-AST-002 for every entry point
f-string, concatenated, %-formatted and .format SQL produce SEC-AST-003
parameterized SQL and argument lists produce no findings
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_audit.py tests/test_security.py -k "ast or eval or shell or sql or Sink or dynamic" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Binary mitigation checker parses real headers
eval_tasks.instruction: ELF program headers and PE DllCharacteristics must decide NX, PIE/ASLR, canary and RELRO, and marker text in data must not fake a pass.
assertions: ELF32/64 in both byte orders pass when hardened
RELRO without BIND_NOW is not Full RELRO
each PE characteristic flag controls only its own check
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_security.py -k "elf or pe or relro or canary or nx or pie or binary or checksec or marker or truncated" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: SARIF output and CI gating
eval_tasks.instruction: Reports must be valid SARIF 2.1.0 and the CLI must exit non-zero on HIGH findings.
assertions: SARIF has version, schema, tool driver and 1-based regions
scan exits 1 on a HIGH finding and 0 on clean code
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_security.py -k "sarif or cli or audit_entry or health or dockerfile" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete AST, binary, reporting and CLI suite passes.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:warnings
